name: VRAM diet
description: Cuts the shell's GPU memory footprint without removing or changing any feature. Drops the unused 2D depth/stencil buffer from every window and offscreen layer, draws the screen frame as strips instead of two screen-sized mask textures, replaces the full-screen corner overlay with four corner-sized windows, skips never-sampled mipmaps on the wallpaper, and decodes the wallpaper at tile size for overview thumbnails and the player background instead of at native 4K.
author: drpezzer
permissions: Sets QSG_NO_DEPTH_BUFFER=1 and QSG_ATLAS_WIDTH/HEIGHT=1024 for the Quickshell process via root-file pragmas
Changes how the screen frame and screen corners are drawn (same appearance, fewer textures and surfaces)
